title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
description: The primary criminal code of India, repealing and replacing the Indian Penal Code, 1860. Defines offences and prescribes punishments for crimes against person, property, and the state.

title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
description: Governs criminal procedure, investigation, arrest, FIR registration, bail, inquiry, and trial in India, replacing the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023
description: Governs the admissibility and evaluation of evidence, including modern digital and electronic records, replacing the Indian Evidence Act, 1872.

title: Information Technology Act, 2000
description: The primary law in India dealing with cybercrime, unauthorized computer access, electronic commerce, digital signatures, and electronic communications.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
description: Protects consumer interests, provides mechanisms for speedy grievance redressal through Consumer Commissions (District, State, National), and tackles unfair trade practices and defective products/services.
